name: Lyo.Images.Skia
tagline: SkiaSharp `IImageService` from `Lyo.Images`: resize, crop, rotate, watermark, convert, thumbnails, compression, metadata, palette, batch.
description:
SkiaSharp implementation of `IImageService` from [`Lyo.Images`](../Lyo.Images/README.md): resize, crop, rotate, watermark, format conversion, thumbnails, compression,
metadata (optional MetadataExtractor EXIF in the Skia pipeline), palette extraction, and batch processing.

examples.title: Usage
Decoration primitives

sections.title: When to use Skia vs ImageSharp
rows: Strong on Linux and mobile. Native Skia assets.
Extended EXIF via MetadataExtractor where wired.

Inherits the ImageSharp-backed `IImageDecorationService` primitives via `ImageServiceBase`. `AddSkiaImageService` does not auto-register `IImageDecorationService` separately. Add `AddImageSharpImageService` first if you want it resolvable as its own type.

sections.title: Types
rows: Metric name strings for Skia operation timings.
sections.trail: Internal helpers (`SkiaExifExtractor`, etc.) are not part of the supported public contract.

sections.title: Decoration primitives
sections.text: `SkiaImageService` inherits the ImageSharp-backed `IImageDecorationService` primitives (`OverlayAsync`, `AddFrameAsync`, `AddCaptionAsync`, `AddOuterPaddingAsync`, plus the `Pipeline(...)` fluent API) through `ImageServiceBase`. To resolve `IImageDecorationService` as its own DI registration alongside Skia, add the ImageSharp registration first:

sections.title: Why pick SkiaSharp
items: Native rendering on Linux and mobile.
Text rendering for watermarks is reliable.
Raster formats include JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, ICO, depending on the Skia build.
